title: Example Demo: The Blueprint
subtitle: This demo is a template. It shows: this is how a demo is built.
description: This demo has no subject. It shows the blueprint of a demo: controls, picture, observing, understanding.

intro.title: This is a template demo
intro.text: This page teaches no subject. It shows you the blueprint. Every part of the page is one building block. Every part explains itself. You can use this page as a template. This is how you build your own demo.

demo.title: The interactive part
demo.lead: The interactive part is the heart of the demo. You use the controls. The picture changes right away. Here it is only colored dots. That is on purpose: it is about the structure, not about a subject.
demo.canvasAria: Picture area with colored dots. The dots react to the controls.

controls.reducedMotion: Your device wants little motion. So the animation is off. The controls still work.

status.reset: The demo is like at the start again.

tooltip.points: This many dots are in the picture. A slider is good for numbers.
tooltip.pattern: This is how the dots are placed. A select list is good for a few options.

structure.title: How a demo is built
structure.intro: Almost every good demo has the same four building blocks. You experience them in this order.

controls.title: Controls
controls.text: Few controls with clear names. A slider for numbers. A select for patterns. Start, pause, and reset. Every control has a label.

viz.title: Picture
viz.text: An area that reacts right away. There is also text instead of the picture. The text is for people with high contrast or a screen reader.

observe.title: Observe
observe.text: You play with the controls. You see right away what happens. Try it: what does the pattern change? What does the slider change?

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: The explanation comes at the end. Also a small test and the most important sentences. Only then playing becomes learning.

checkpoint.title: Test: Do you know the blueprint?
checkpoint.item1: I can name the four building blocks: controls, picture, observing, understanding.

takeaways.title: Key takeaways
takeaways.text:
1. **Four building blocks**: controls, picture, observing, understanding. Every demo follows this order.

2. **Instant answer**: you use a control. The picture changes right away.

3. **For all people**: labels, screen reader hints, and little motion belong in from the start.

This demo has no subject. Swap the dots for your subject. Keep the structure.

build.title: Build your own demo
build.text: This page is your template. Swap the interactive part for your subject. Keep the structure. In developer mode two tools help you:
build.designWorkshop: the design workshop: there you try out all building blocks
build.newComponent: the guided way to add a new building block
